content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm attempting to increase the PI trend scale by a factor of 100, but I haven't been able to locate a relevant setting within the PI controller interface. Any suggestions would be appreciated. Best regards, [user_name]
The functionality you want is currently unavailable. Could you share why you need the view scaled up by 100x?

analysis.insight_summary: Users reported difficulty in changing the scale of the PI trend chart within [product_name]. The absence of an option to significantly increase the PI trend scale, such as by 100x, highlights limited customization capabilities in the visualization tool, which may hinder advanced data analysis. The needed feature appears either not implemented or hard to find.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an option within the product to customize or increase the PI trend scale substantially, offering better flexibility for visual analysis.
